title: Unique identity-on-sections restriction comparison under coefficient charts
statement: Let W be a scheme, R and S commutative internal ring objects in abelian sheaves on W_proet, and φ : R → S a ring-object map. Let ψ be the reconstructed section-ring map of φ. For arbitrary section-ring charts eR : sectionRingSheaf R ≅ A and eS : sectionRingSheaf S ≅ B, let ER and ES be the section module equivalences transported through the charts [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]. Then Mod.comap φ ⋙ ER has a unique natural isomorphism to ES ⋙ pbcRestrict (eR.inv ≫ ψ ≫ eS.hom) [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] acting by the identity on every module section (expressed by HEq).

source.place: Stacks 00YV, and the section-encoding portion of sk-thm-purity-transport Steps 2--3. Agent-formulated comparison lemma, completely proved in Lean.

proof.text: Apply the functor forgetting commutative ring sheaves to ring sheaves. The chart inverse identities show that the conjugated coefficient square commutes. The identity of section groups is therefore linear for the two restricted scalar actions and defines a module-sheaf isomorphism. Combine it with sectionModuleComapIso and the chart equivalence to obtain the desired natural isomorphism. Its components act identically on every section. The same section formula for any competitor proves equality of all components and hence uniqueness.

theorem normalizedEncodingRestriction (W : Scheme.{u})
    (R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] [MonObj S] [IsCommMonObj S]
    (φ : R ⟶ S) [IsMonHom φ]
    (ψ : InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology W) R ⟶
        InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (ProEt.topology W) S) (hφ : ψ = CondensedRing.sectionRingMap W φ)
    (A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (eR : InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology W) R ≅ A)
    (eS : InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology W) S ≅ B) :
    let ER := (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionModuleEquivalence.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology W) R).functor ⋙
        (CondensedRing.ringModuleEquivalenceOfIso W ((adicLisseForget W).mapIso eR).symm).functor
    let ES := (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionModuleEquivalence.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology W) S).functor ⋙
        (CondensedRing.ringModuleEquivalenceOfIso W ((adicLisseForget W).mapIso eS).symm).functor
    ∃! d : Mod.comap φ ⋙ ER ≅
        ES ⋙ pbcRestrict (eR.inv ≫ ψ ≫ eS.hom),
      ∀ (M : Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) Ab.{u + 1}) S) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (((Mod.comap φ ⋙ ER).obj M).val.obj U)),
        HEq ((d.hom.app M).val.app U x) x
